provenance: Original STAT 709 drawings from canonical examples; synthetic samples are explicitly labeled. No external artwork copied.

figures.name: convergence-grid
figures.title: Convergence in probability and sample paths
figures.alt: Gold cells mark errors exceeding a fixed tolerance. A column compares outcomes at one n; each row follows one outcome through time. The finite schematic illustrates the quantifiers, not a proof of convergence.

figures.name: normal-scales
figures.title: Normal errors at three scales
figures.alt: Centered Normal densities with standard deviations 0.4, 1 and 2 have unit area. Smaller error scales concentrate probability near zero.
